en.topic_title: Hong Kong trade office expansion unaffected by UK spy case, commerce chief says
en.topic_summary:
“Unfounded smears” about a UK court case that found a Hong Kong trade officer guilty of spying on overseas activists will not affect the government’s plans to expand trade offices in other countries, the city’s commerce chief has said.
